thread:
sam_sales: passing Novella Bio over to CS — signed ARR $120k, primary use is private inference for clinical-document summarization, will need VPC peering + SSO. Contact at customer is Kevin (Novella) <kevin@novella.com>. Renewal window in 10 months, finance still needs final approval but sales pushed signature.

maria_cs: thanks — adding context and owners. i'll lead onboarding. key risks?

sam_sales: biggest blockers are SSO (SAML + IdP metadata), VPC peering with their AWS account (they want dedicated subnet), and proof-of-concept for throughput (they expect <100ms median latency at 512 tokens). they asked for private deploy (customer wants data residency).

devon_se: i'll own the perf PoC and quantization notes. i'll spin up a test plan. can i get sample docs and expected QPS?

sam_sales: sending sample dataset to you via secure share. QPS target = 5 sustained, spikes to 20.

onboard-bot: NOTE: onboarding ticket created #ONB-4921 (owner: maria_cs).

maria_cs: created internal checklist and owners: SE PoC = devon_se, infra handoff = karen_eng, support escalation = ian_support. i'll schedule kickoff Wednesday 10am PT.

karen_eng: i'll start VPC peering request. need their VPC id and cidr whitelist. sam, can you confirm if they want cross-account ENIs or VPN?

sam_sales: they prefer VPC peering + route tables; not a VPN. sending VPC id in DM.

ian_support: noted for support. i'll pre-create runbook for common issues (SSO failures, KV cache warm-up, GPU OOM). will add rollback steps for canary deploy.

maria_cs: action list for first week: 1) SAML metadata exchange (owner: sam_sales). 2) VPC peering + subnet routes (owner: karen_eng). 3) Perf PoC with 512 token profile (owner: devon_se). 4) Private deploy sign-off and SOC checklist (owner: maria_cs). 5) Support runbook + oncall rotation (owner: ian_support). i'll put owners in the ticket.

devon_se: quick note — for the PoC i'll run baseline using model-x-quant8 and model-x-fp16 to show cost/latency tradeoffs. will post results to the ticket.

maria_cs: renewal risk: finance flagged seat-based pricing vs usage. put renewal_watch = true on account, schedule quarterly exec check-ins (owner: sam_sales + maria_cs).

sam_sales: agreed. they may push to an internal RFP in 8 months; flag for AE.

onboard-bot: FYI: doc upload link created: https://files.redwood.internal/onboard/ONB-4921 with sample dataset placeholder.

ian_support: can we add a pre-production route to replicate their exact networking? karen, do we have a sandbox VPC for validation?

karen_eng: yes — i'll provision sandbox VPC and post creds to the ticket. i'll also create a security group template for them.

maria_cs: one more ask from the customer: audit logging and KMS integration. need engineering review for HSM/KMS limitations on private deploy. karen_eng and ian_support, can you confirm by EOD tomorrow?

karen_eng: will check KMS policies and HSM compatibility.

ian_support: will list any observed audit gaps and mitigation.

sam_sales: thanks team. Kevin is keen on a tight timeline — wants POC in 2 weeks. probable go-live in ~6 weeks pending approvals.

maria_cs: i'll send calendar invite for kickoff, populate ONB-4921 with owner tasks and acceptance criteria. please update ticket with any blockers. :thumbsup:

devon_se: copying planned test matrix into ticket now.

onboard-bot: Ticket ONB-4921 updated: owners assigned, kickoff scheduled.

maria_cs: closing loop here — if anything high-priority pops up tag @maria_cs and @ian_support so we can triage quickly.

sam_sales: thanks all — appreciate the fast turn. :rocket:
